description:
Job Summary: 

 
 We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented UI Developer to join our product engineering team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and developing intuitive, responsive, and visually appealing user interfaces that provide an exceptional user experience across web applications.

 This role requires strong expertise in HTML, CSS, JavaScript , and modern UI development practices, along with hands-on experience in wireframing, prototyping, and collaborating with UX designers and development teams . The candidate should have a passion for creating pixel-perfect interfaces while ensuring usability, accessibility, and performance.

 

 Required Technical Skills & Competencies 

 
 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Design, or a related field.

 1+ years of experience in UI Development or Front-End Development.

 Strong proficiency in:
 
 HTML5

 CSS3

 JavaScript (ES6+)

 

 Experience developing responsive and mobile-friendly web applications.

 Hands-on experience creating wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes.

 Strong understanding of UI/UX design principles and usability best practices.

 Experience translating design specifications into high-quality interfaces.

 Familiarity with browser developer tools and debugging techniques.

 Understanding of accessibility standards and responsive design methodologies.

 Experience using version control tools such as Git/GitHub.

 Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
 

 

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: USD 30,000

 Maximum Compensation: USD 105,000

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post
